meta.subject: fixed deadlock in fetch stage when l1 is disabled

en.summary: The commit fixes a front-end deadlock by adding feedback from ibuffer dequeue events to fetch request throttling, so instruction fetch cannot outrun the instruction buffer when cache responses share a stalled bus.
why_it_counts: The patch changes front-end DUT control across decode, ibuffer, icache stage, and interfaces
The new logic explicitly tracks outstanding fetch reads against actual ibuffer consumption
The added comment in VX_icache_stage names the deadlock mechanism when L1 is disabled and icache/dcache share the same bus
evidence: VX_icache_stage adds per-warp pending_reads counters, increments them on icache_req_fire, decrements them on ifetch_rsp_if.ibuf_pop, and blocks new requests when pending_reads_full is set
VX_decode and the interface files add ibuf_pop feedback from the ibuffer back into the ifetch response path
VX_ibuffer now exposes per-warp dequeue events through decode_if.ibuf_pop, providing the retirement signal needed to release pending fetch credits

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A front end that issues instruction fetches into an instruction buffer must limit outstanding fetch traffic using real consumption credits, not just cache-side ready/valid. When fetch responses and other memory traffic share a bottlenecked bus, the front end can deadlock if it keeps issuing fetches after the instruction buffer is effectively full and has no feedback path that retires outstanding fetch credits when buffered instructions are actually consumed.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: Instruction fetch responses share a constrained path with other traffic, the instruction buffer fills, and decode or execute stalls delay ibuffer consumption
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Remove the feedback path that decrements outstanding fetch credits on instruction-buffer dequeue, and stop throttling fetch requests based on those credits
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: drop dequeue-driven credit retirement for fetch outstanding-count control
portability_notes: Map this to any front end where fetch requests can be outstanding independently of whether the instruction buffer is draining
The key bug is missing retirement feedback from actual instruction consumption, not merely a small buffer depth
If the DUT uses tokens or credits rather than a counter, stop returning a token when an ibuffer entry is popped
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the logic that limits the number of outstanding fetch requests per warp, thread, or fetch stream
Identify the event that should retire one outstanding fetch credit when an instruction-buffer entry is truly consumed
Remove that retirement event from the outstanding-count logic, or stop using the resulting full signal to throttle new fetch requests
Keep the rest of the fetch and decode datapath intact so the injected bug is specifically loss of credit feedback

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: per-warp pending_reads accounting and ibuf_pop feedback across the fetch/ibuffer boundary
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix adds ibuf_pop feedback from the ibuffer to ifetch, counts pending reads per warp in VX_icache_stage, and blocks new fetch requests when pending_reads reaches instruction-buffer capacity.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Delete or ignore ifetch_rsp_if.ibuf_pop in VX_icache_stage so pending_reads is no longer decremented by actual ibuffer pops, and remove the pending_reads_full gating from ifetch_req_if.ready/icache_req_if.valid.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: When the instruction buffer stops draining under shared-bus pressure, fetch continues to over-issue until the front end loses the credits needed to make progress, recreating the deadlock seen with L1 disabled.
evidence_for_injection: The patch comment in VX_icache_stage explicitly says the new logic ensures the ibuffer does not fill up and resolves a deadlock when icache and dcache share the same bus
pending_reads counters are the new mechanism that gates fetch issue and are driven by real ibuffer pop events
The interface additions exist only to carry ibuf_pop feedback, which identifies the essential repair path
notes: For portability, describe this as outstanding-credit retirement tied to instruction consumption
A smaller mutation can keep the new interfaces but stop decrementing pending_reads on ibuf_pop

zh.summary: 该提交通过把 ibuffer 出队事件反馈给 fetch 侧的请求节流逻辑，修复了前端死锁问题；这样在 cache 响应与其他流量共享受阻总线时，取指就不会跑得比 instruction buffer 的真实消费速度更快。
why_it_counts: 补丁跨 decode、ibuffer、icache stage 和接口文件修改了前端 DUT 控制逻辑
新增逻辑会根据 ibuffer 的真实消费情况跟踪未完成取指请求数量
VX_icache_stage 中新增的注释直接说明：在关闭 L1 且 icache/dcache 共用总线时，这一机制用于消除死锁
evidence: VX_icache_stage 新增按 warp 统计的 pending_reads 计数器，在 icache_req_fire 时加一，在 ifetch_rsp_if.ibuf_pop 时减一，并在 pending_reads_full 时阻止新请求
VX_decode 与接口文件新增了从 ibuffer 回传到 ifetch response 路径的 ibuf_pop 反馈
VX_ibuffer 现在通过 decode_if.ibuf_pop 暴露每个 warp 的真实 dequeue 事件，为释放 pending fetch credit 提供退休信号

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 一个把取指请求送入 instruction buffer 的前端，必须依据“真实的指令消费 credit”来限制未完成取指数量，而不能只依赖 cache 侧 ready/valid。当取指响应与其他内存流量共享同一个瓶颈总线时，如果前端在 instruction buffer 实际已经满载的情况下仍继续发请求，而且又没有在 buffer 条目真正被消费时回收 outstanding fetch credit 的反馈路径，就很容易在共享总线压力下死锁。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: fetch 到 ibuffer 的 outstanding credit 计数
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 取指响应与其他流量共享受限路径，instruction buffer 填满，而 decode 或 execute 阶段的阻塞又延迟了 ibuffer 消费
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 删除基于 instruction-buffer 出队事件回收 outstanding fetch credit 的反馈路径，并停止用这些 credit 去节流新的 fetch 请求
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 删除由 dequeue 事件驱动的取指 credit 回收
portability_notes: 适用于任何“取指请求可以独立 outstanding，而 instruction buffer 排空速度又可能变慢”的前端设计
关键缺陷是丢失了由真实指令消费驱动的退休反馈，而不仅仅是 buffer 太小
如果 DUT 用 token 或 credit 而不是计数器，就让 ibuffer pop 时不再归还 token
concrete_injection_steps: 找到限制每个 warp、线程或 fetch stream 未完成取指数量的控制逻辑
识别在 instruction-buffer 条目真正被消费时，应当回收一个 outstanding fetch credit 的事件
把该事件从 outstanding 计数逻辑中移除，或停止使用其生成的 full 信号去节流新的 fetch 请求
保持其余 fetch 与 decode 数据通路不变，使注入后的错误明确属于 credit 反馈丢失

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: fetch 与 ibuffer 边界上的 ibuf_pop 反馈以及按 warp 统计的 pending_reads
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复增加了从 ibuffer 到 ifetch 的 ibuf_pop 反馈，在 VX_icache_stage 中按 warp 统计 pending_reads，并在 pending_reads 达到 instruction-buffer 容量时阻止继续发新的 fetch 请求。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 VX_icache_stage 中删除或忽略 ifetch_rsp_if.ibuf_pop，使 pending_reads 不再因真实 ibuffer pop 而递减，并移除 ifetch_req_if.ready 与 icache_req_if.valid 上的 pending_reads_full 限制。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 当 instruction buffer 在共享总线压力下停止排空时，fetch 仍会继续超发请求，直到前端失去前进所需的 credit，再次重现关闭 L1 时的死锁。
evidence_for_injection: VX_icache_stage 中新增注释明确写明：该逻辑用于防止 ibuffer 填满，并修复 icache 与 dcache 共用总线时的死锁
pending_reads 计数器是新增的核心机制，它直接由真实 ibuffer pop 事件驱动并用于节流 fetch 发射
接口层新增字段只为传递 ibuf_pop 反馈而存在，这清楚地标出了核心修复路径
notes: 为了跨 DUT 复用，应把该错误描述成“取指 outstanding credit 的退休反馈依赖真实指令消费”
更小的变异方式是保留新接口，但停止用 ibuf_pop 去递减 pending_reads
